title: NBA: Pistons snaps Spurs streak, Lakers rally to beat Hornets in OT
summary: Cade Cunningham scored 27 points as the Detroit Pistons ended the San Antonio Spurs' 12-game winning streak with a gritty 105-93 victory on the road on Tuesday.
